rationale: The workflow already caches Maven dependencies (path ~/.m2, keyed on hashFiles('**/pom.xml') with restore keys), which is the optimization supported by P-LIT-GHA-CACHE and the measured cache experiment. That pattern explicitly lists "An equivalent cache already exists" as a contraindication, so adding another cache would be redundant and would not preserve a minimal change. Other candidate patterns do not fit: there is no matrix (fail-fast N/A), a deploy job that publishes to Sonatype exists (cancel-stale is contraindicated for release/deployment work), there are no scheduled triggers (schedule-related patterns N/A), and a custom timeout lacks sufficient representative duration history and risks failing valid cold/slow Maven builds. Build/test coverage, permissions, secrets usage, and network access are left unchanged; no privileged actions, publishing/deployment operations, or new network access are introduced.
